name: Mertva
source:
Life in this world is hard and fun, it is full of love and suffering at the same time. And sometimes it happens that such a routine continues even after death.

So listen, sons, to mothers, and beware of evil power, because that evil power is not only devils and leshy, but also dead girls. Some of them drown, others tickle, and others can dance you to death.

[Translated from [url=https://lassia.itch.io/mertva]itch.io[/url]]
